title: Camp Lazlo: Paintcan Panic
read_from: programs/25.swf, AS2 (Flash 7): GameBoard, Hero, Enemy, Edward, Chip
start: the title screen's START, then PLAY
the level prompt ('LEVEL n / Paint q% of the ground to continue.') goes on by any key
the engine runs from then on every frame (GameBoard.update)

controls.two arrows together: run diagonally, each axis at speed / 1.4
controls.z: jump: keeps running the way she faces; paints nothing; enemies cannot hit her while it lasts
controls.w, l: end the level passed / failed: cheat keys, listened to only where _cheatKeys is true, which it is not

hers.blocked_by: the level's obstacles (canoe, bush1, cage, bushwall, downtree, stump, tools, chair, cooler, speaker, tree, grass, totempole, cow, sacks, chest, bush2)

goal.how: running (not jumping) over a 30 x 25 cell not yet painted paints it
goal.won: the 'win' screen, after the twentieth level is passed

hazards.does: steers toward her: speed grows by 0.2 a frame to 0.4, added to a velocity kept at 0.97 a frame (about 13 px a frame at most), turning with inertia
hazards.touch: within 15 px: costs 1000 paint unless she is jumping; then every enemy backs off to 80 px and chases again 2 s later

hazards.does: the same, at most 0.15 (about 5 px a frame)

readouts.score: added after a level: coverage x 100, paint left x 2, a bonus for each try not lost, 1000 for no hits

families: a body steered with the arrows, 8 ways
a jump that cannot be hit
what_wins: run the field in rows over ground not yet painted, never back over painted ground where it can be helped; jump with z when a chaser is close and coming on
